expo.name: Goalfer
expo.description: Transform your life with Goalfer - the social habit tracker that helps you build lasting routines through accountability, motivation, and community support.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Goalfer requests camera access to let you take profile pictures that personalize your experience and help friends recognize you in the social features. Camera access is completely optional and only used when you choose to update your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Goalfer requests photo library access to let you choose existing photos for your profile picture. This helps personalize your experience and makes it easier for friends to recognize you in social features. Photo access is completely optional and only used when you choose to update your profile picture.
